name: Gaussian Splatting
definition: 3DGS models a scene as a collection of M 3D Gaussians to overcome the computational cost of evaluating the volume rendering equation via quadrature, which requires querying points outside Gaussian supports. It uses volume splatting for efficient rasterization.
summary: Gaussian Splatting is a novel-view synthesis method that replaces ray marching with tile-based rasterization of 3D Gaussian primitives, enabling real-time rendering speeds while maintaining photorealistic quality.
